description: Ancient sandstone ruins half-buried in endless dunes. The wind whispers forgotten secrets through broken arches.
A warm, smoky tavern lit by flickering lanterns. The smell of roasted meat and spilled ale fills the air.
Floating islands above a sea of clouds. Waterfalls plunge into the void. Strange birds sing in the thin air.
A forest of glowing mushrooms and silver-leafed trees. Tiny lights dance between the trunks.
